name: auth-form
title: Auth form
description: The site's sign-in and sign-up form in a 400px column: the title and lead, a quiet provider button, the or rule, the email field with its message beside the label, the one White button, the legal line and the way to the other mode; a pressed button shows a spinner until the app takes over.
use_for: Signing in or up on a page of your own, or inside a dialog; the sign-in page uses it.
never: A third-party logo shipped with the library: the provider's mark comes in through `providerIcon` (the `provider-icon` slot)
Errors in red: the message is White beside the label and the field's ring turns White
source: Site pages/Auth/AuthForm and Auth.module.css: title h4 32/36, h3 40/44 from 768, at 450; lead --text-2 12px under; controls 48px (--control-m) with 16/24 labels; the or rule 14/20 --text-3 between --line hairlines, 16px above and below; the field on --raised with an inset --line ring, 8px corner; legal 14/20 --text-off with --text-2 links; the spinner 20px, a 2px ring turning every 800ms

<!-- The form alone, for a page of your own: sign up with a neutral mark in the provider button. -->
<spyglass-auth-form id="auth-form" mode="sign-up"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-key-round" slot="provider-icon" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2.586 17.414A2 2 0 0 0 2 18.828V21a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h3a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-1a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h1a1 1 0 0 0 1-1v-1a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h.172a2 2 0 0 0 1.414-.586l.814-.814a6.5 6.5 0 1 0-4-4z"></path><circle cx="16.5" cy="7.5" r=".5" fill="currentColor"></circle></svg></spyglass-auth-form>
<script type="module">
  const form = document.getElementById('auth-form')
  form.addEventListener('provider', (event) => event.preventDefault())
  form.addEventListener('email', (event) => event.preventDefault())
</script>
